title: FR: Don't Snooze Alert in Android top sliding panel
body:
1 Don't Snooze Alert in Android top sliding panel. When I delete (or even open) BG message in Andriod top sliding panel by default it snoozes alert with defined time:
Picture:

![photo_2020-12-28_15-53-21 c](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31447095/103219276-e0db0600-4925-11eb-8d5b-3e29c4175ab2.jpg)

Please, dissable or make optionable (possible to disable) snoozing here. I'd prefer to snooze alerts only ("inside") from xDrip. ... 2 "Start Snoozed" — it would be nice to have separate time setting for this function than regular snooze time because when we deal with regular snooze we are snoozing (for example for hour) alert that already active/sounded; but with Start Snoozed we can wish to fix wrong alerts from sensor noices (https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/342) and it's preferable to set less time here (for example 15 min). Thanks.
